name: Shuvovai Bullion Rates for Kolkata Widget
author: shuvovai

sections.description:
Shuvovai Bullion Rates for Kolkata Widget is a powerful and completely free script designed to display live gold and silver rates. With this plugin, you can effortlessly provide your website visitors with the accurate Kolkata gold price today, keeping them updated on a daily basis. Using a reliable India API connection, this widget automatically updates daily prices for your users. It features a beautiful widget design, built-in dynamic calculator (Bori, Gram, Ana, Roti), and historical data display.

Features:
* 100% Free script for live Gold & Silver rates directly from a central India API.
* Beautifully designed frontend widget using shortcode [kgpl_kolkata_gold_live].
* Manual price override options from the admin settings.
* Color and SEO title customization.
* Built-in dynamic calculator for customers.
* Full Bengali language support.

External Services

This plugin utilizes a third-party/external API service to retrieve real-time gold and silver rates.

  • Service Name: Gold Live India Server API
  • What it is used for: It fetches the daily live pricing data for various carats of gold and silver to display accurately inside the widget.
  • What data is sent and when: When this plugin is activated or when the widget fetches data, it securely sends your website’s domain name (e.g., yoursite.com) to the API server to register the domain and authenticate the connection. No user or personal data is collected or sent.
  • Service Provider: Gold Live India (https://goldliveindia.com/)
  • Terms of Service: https://goldliveindia.com/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://goldliveindia.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Kolkata Gold Live” menu in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Enter your license key, configure the colors and/or manual prices.
  5. Use the shortcode [kgpl_kolkata_gold_live] on any page or post to display the widget.
sections.faq:
How do I display the widget?

Simply use the [kgpl_kolkata_gold_live] shortcode inside any post, page, or text widget.

Can I set manual prices?

Yes, you can input manual prices from the plugin settings page. This works perfectly even if you are not using the live API.
